'''2001 Washington State Championship Nick Jones LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2001 Washington State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Nick "The Quick" Jones (2005-02-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34499 WA State 2001 (LS) Winner!]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050518071359/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=34499&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' 2001 event, outside the 2002-2006 scope (posted Feb 2005); kept because it turned up in the same crawl.<ref name="src" />
